items.what: Publish the director record at /director/ to crawlers -- an irretractable public claim under Poesys's name: move a deliberately unadvertised surface into the crawlable set (sitemap entry + noindex removed). Director's condition, ruled 2026-08-18: he reads the page's RENDERED content as a stranger would, first.
items.how: Worker renders /director/ as it will be SERVED -- driven by its live feeds, the visible text a stranger meets, not the markup and not a summary -- and puts that in front of the director. His word then goes into docs/observability/director_record_publication_release.json {released:true, director_words:..., render_shown:...}, which is what site/ia_register.py::director_record_publication_violations reads. Until then the three publication acts (sitemap entry, INTERNAL_DOORS removal, noindex drop) are refused by site/test_ia_register.py. No new gate, seam or channel is on the director's path.
items.why: His words: 'show me its rendered content before it becomes crawlable -- it was written internally and I want to read it as a stranger would first.' Silence does NOT release this one; that carve-out from THE_STANDARD is his, made in the same breath as accepting the recommendation. A later noindex does not retract a page from an index.
